shortDescription: Remote Support operations on a PowerStore storage system

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: is_cloudiq_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether support for CloudIQ is enabled.

options.name: is_icw_configured
options.description: Client already configured ICW.

options.name: is_rsc_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether support for Remote Service Credentials is enabled.

options.name: is_support_assist_license_accepted
options.description: Indicates whether user has accepted remote support license agreement before enabling the Support Assist on the system for the first time.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: proxy_address
options.description: Proxy server IP address (IPv4).

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: Password for proxy server access.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: Proxy server port number.

options.name: proxy_username
options.description: User name for proxy server access.

options.name: remote_support_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the remote support configuration.

options.name: remote_support_servers
options.description: One or two remote support servers.

options.name: return_support_license_text
options.description: Indicates whether to return support license agreement text or not.

options.name: send_test_alert
options.description: Indicates whether to send a test alert or not.

options.name: server_state
options.description: Indicates the state of the remote_support_servers. Required with I(remote_support_servers).

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the remote support configuration after the task is performed. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent). For get/modify operation it should be set to C(present).

options.name: support_type
options.description: The type of remote support that is configured. Mandatory for modify and verify operation. C(SRS_Gateway), I(support_type) is only supported for verify operation.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: verify_connection
options.description: Indicates whether to perform the verify call or not.

options.name: wait_for_completion
options.description: Flag to indicate if the operation should be run synchronously or asynchronously. C(true) signifies synchronous execution. By default, modify operation will run asynchronously.
